movelist.name: Haze
movelist.effect: The Combat Stages of the user and all Pokémon and Trainers in the encounter are set to their default state (usually 0).

movelist.name: Sandstorm
movelist.effect: The weather changes to a Sandstorm for 5 rounds. While it is Sandstorming, all non-Ground, Rock, or Steel Type Pokémon lose a Tick of Hit Points at the beginning of their turn.

movelist.name: Bind
movelist.effect: The user gains a +1 Bonus to Accuracy Rolls made to initiate Grapple Maneuvers, and +2 to Skill Checks made to initiate Grapple Maneuvers or gain Dominance. Whenever the user gains Dominance in a Grapple, the target of the Grapple loses a Tick of Hit Points.

movelist.name: Safeguard
movelist.effect: Blessing – Any user affected by Safeguard may activate it when receiving a Status Affliction to ignore the effects of that Status Affliction on their next turn. Safeguard may be activated 3 times, and then disappears.

abilities.name: Aura Break
abilities.effect: The foe reveals its abilities. Pick one ability; any Damage Bonuses (either Damage Base increases or Damage Roll bonuses) granted by the ability instead become Damage Penalties of the same value.

abilities.name: Filter
abilities.effect: The user gains +5 Damage Reduction against Super- Effective damage. Defensive.

abilities.name: Pressure
abilities.effect: All foes within 3 meters are Suppressed for 1 full round.
